thread:
Nina: Quick sync: postmortem followups keep stalling. Proposing an enforceable mini workflow.
Omar: +1. make it frictionless.
Lei: Proposal: single-line actions that OpsBot can parse + owner ack requirement. Fields: Action, Owner, Priority, Due, Verify, Blockers.
Priya: Add CustomerImpact: yes/no and Rollback: optional. Cadence: 24h ack, 48h quick-check, weekly until closed.
Nina: For recurrence: if same symptom 3x in 60 days -> tag recurring and open a 3-day spike.
Omar: IC rotation tweak: default 1-week, opt-in 2-week. 20m handoff doc with top 5 bullets.
Lei: Closure must include a verification artifact (logs, test, PR) or reviewer ack for process items.
OpsBot: I will parse pasted action bullets, create a JIRA incident ticket label=incident-1755556789, ping owner, and post reminders at 24h and 72h.
Priya: Next steps: Nina updates the followup template; Omar wires the calendar; Lei drafts verification examples. Reconvene Friday 15min to smoke-test parser.
